title: Math: Multiplication ✖️
summary:
1. What is Multiplication?
Multiplication is a quick way to add the same number again and again. The symbol is ✖️ (times).
• 2 + 2 + 2 is the same as 3 groups of 2 or 3 x 2 = 6.

2. Equal Groups & Arrays
• Equal Groups: Putting things in boxes with the same amount. Example: 2 boxes with 3 apples is 2 x 3.
• Arrays: Arranging things in neat rows and columns.

3. Number Lines
You can multiply by skipping numbers on a number line!
• Jumps of 2: 0 ➔ 2 ➔ 4 ➔ 6 (3 jumps of 2 is 6).

4. Times Tables to know!
Practice your 1, 2, 3, and 10 times tables!

0 ➔ 2 ➔ 4 ➔ 6 ➔ 8 ➔ 10
